extraction.Name: Charging Iron Shooter
extraction.Occupation/Income: I Farm some, work for the Government and raise and sell horses.
extraction.NOTES: Received patent by mail in February 1919; signed a receipt for it; sold land for $5300.00 — $2800.00 in cash and 25 head of horses valued at $100 each; transaction was satisfactory to him; in about 1910 made an application for a patent before A. K. Wood and never heard from it; four children depend upon him for support; subscribed and sworn before A. W. Cross, Notary Public, on May 15, 1929; commission expires 4-28-32; document page reference 156. | TASK 5 CAT_3 BACKFILL 2026-05-04 (patents database): Allotment 156, tribe Rosebud Sioux, sourced from federal-register-app patents database (Christian's research).
